name: clinic-business-software
description: Full-stack clinic business management software (patients, appointments, doctors, billing).

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --workspace backend && npm run prisma:migrate --workspace backend && npm run seed --workspace backend
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
